parts.name: Badge
parts.description: A count, dot or text indicator attached to child content. Native span attributes and ref apply to the outer wrapper.

props.name: children
props.description: Anchor content that remains interactive when the indicator is hidden.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible indicator label; also the fallback text for variant="label".

props.name: variant
props.description: Choose a count, a dot or a text label.

props.name: count
props.description: Non-negative integer count, used by the count variant.

props.name: max
props.description: Positive integer display cap. Larger counts display max followed by +.

props.name: content
props.description: Visible text for the label variant; falls back to label.

props.name: invisible
props.description: Hide the indicator while preserving its child content.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner where the indicator is attached to its anchor.

props.name: tone
props.description: Indicator palette: default ink or danger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
